title: My Half-Sister Forged A Dissolution And Sold My $640K Trunk Collection. So I Voided The Sale
description: After my half-sister forged a dissolution, sold our restored Louis Vuitton trunks for $640,000, and mailed me a $3,700 'baggage' check, I retrieved the original agreement from a false-bottomed trunk and voided the sale. Now she polishes brass locks at my atelier in an apron that says 'Unlatched Lies.' #RevengeStory #FamilyBetrayal #InheritanceDrama
thumb_text: SHE FORGED THE SALE AND LOST EVERYTHING
pinned_comment: If your half-sister forged a dissolution and mailed you a $3,700 'baggage' check for a $640,000 trunk collection, what would you have done? Tell me in the comments if you have ever had a family member try to erase your share of an inheritance.

thumb_lines.text: SENT ME A $3,700 BAGGAGE CHECK TO ERASE ME
